assertions: Explicit stable numeric phase/reason/raw-error-domain identifiers and known-field bits round-trip without relying on enum declaration order or sentinel values.
Cover parse, creation and timeout producers; signed Vulkan error, parser error code/offset and native error retain exact domain/value when available. Unknown raw error stays unknown, not VK_SUCCESS.

Known zero hash/raw value/worker/attempt and empty ranges remain distinguishable from absent fields; absent tag/hash/range/worker/attempt does not acquire a value during serialization or controller association. Controller-owned worker/attempt/range context is explicitly marked as controller-known, not worker-reported.
Unknown reason/phase/raw-domain numeric IDs remain opaque/unknown and never map to a known category or success; stable supported IDs retain meanings in golden wire fixtures.

For every representative legal OFFER/HELLO/EVENT/FINAL frame, feed every two-part split including 0 and full length, then every-byte fragmentation and multiple concatenated frames; exact emitted records/order/fields match the unsplit golden fixture.

Explicit byte count handles embedded NUL, non-ASCII/invalid bytes, CR/LF variants, decimal overflow, signed overflow, invalid flags/field combinations, invalid lengths and trailing junk without C-string truncation or unchecked numeric conversion.

Feed each truncated prefix then EOF: no partial record is accepted; retained protocol state exposes incomplete/truncated evidence. Oversized declared/actual records and arbitrarily long unterminated input never exceed the documented fixed buffer/frame/storage caps; discard/recovery never joins an invalid prefix to a later valid record.

After malformed/oversized/unknown-version/reason input, feed a valid frame and assert the documented resynchronization policy, explicit protocol uncertainty and no fabricated successful final. Unknown frame kinds are safely bounded and accounted for.

Parent explicitly offers bounded supported versions before child replay; child selects an offered supported version in HELLO, controller validates that selection before accepting new data. Suggested transport is first-line OFFER on existing stdin hash-list pipe, followed by normal module hashes and EOF; HELLO precedes events on output. This is an actual offer/selection exchange, not just an unexplained hard-coded version token.

Supported overlap succeeds; no overlap, absent/malformed selection, data before HELLO, duplicate/conflicting HELLO, unsupported selection and unknown wire version leave structured context incomplete/unsupported. No unbounded handshake wait or new pipe deadlock.

Absent offer on direct legacy slave invocation remains an explicit legacy path with old message semantics; no negotiated rich-evidence claim. Preserve first legacy faulty-module hash rather than consuming it as an offer.
Negotiation and stream parser state reset per worker attempt. Stale worker/attempt mismatches cannot overwrite the current attempt or certify its FINAL.

assertions: Kill or exit worker before its first report and assert observed native status, controller-known worker/attempt/ranges, unknown root cause/resource identity and unsuccessful unresolved work.

Drop complete FINAL, truncate FINAL at each relevant boundary, drop HELLO, and exit zero after reporting only events: negotiated result remains incomplete/unknown and cannot claim complete success. Preserve any independently received originating parse/create/timeout facts.

Truncated/oversized/unknown-version/reason reports are integrated through actual controller transport, not just a parser unit; protocol loss/unsupported fields are observable in retained state. An EOF callback must run on normal shutdown, pending Windows overlapped completion, and error cleanup.

A valid FINAL does not override nonzero/abnormal native termination; duplicate/conflicting FINAL and data from a prior attempt cannot certify success. No inferred individual culprit from a range alone.

Golden legacy CRASH, MODULE[_UUID], GRAPHICS/COMPUTE/RAYTRACE, *_VERR, heartbeat, TIMEOUT/TERMINATE and REPLAY_FAILED fixtures preserve their prior meanings and optional shared-ring forwarding. New rich records are additive internal protocol; no general mixed-version rich-evidence guarantee.

original.requirement:
Legacy identity: `FOS-000009`. Original source: [immutable historical definition](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/73f891d6c0cf498ac92e804d7d0f0cd344a083f5/local-docs/reviews/observability-sweep.md).

Shared requirements and grouping: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8. All original criteria below remain required. Source status statements below describe their historical revision; current delivery evidence is recorded separately. Original relative links are resolved below.

## Original definition (verbatim)

9. **FOS-000009 — Carry reason data from the place that detects it.** **M; depends on `FOS-000005`, `FOS-000007`, `FOS-000008`; §1, §4–§5.** Add a small stable internal result/event representation: phase, reason ID, known raw error, tag/hash or range, worker and attempt, plus unknown-context flags. Start with parse, creation and timeout paths. Extend child messages on both platforms with explicit framing/version negotiation and bounded parsing; never require the controller to infer categories from human logs. **Check:** split/truncated messages, unknown version/reason, missing final message, worker exit before first report. Unknown information stays unknown. This is where downstream controllers acquire causes; a parent-only summary cannot recover details a worker never sends.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **Result serialization and streaming-parser unit tests:** Each migrated producer preserves reason, phase, raw error and applicable identity through a round trip. Feed every split position, multiple records per read, truncated/oversized records and unknown versions/reasons; parsing stays bounded and never converts absent context into known values.
   - **Worker/controller integration tests:** With worker prose disabled, injected parse, creation and timeout failures remain distinguishable at the controller. Death before the first report and loss of the final report yield explicit uncertainty rather than fabricated resource identity or success.

<!-- fossilize-migration-v1:FOS-000009 -->

risks: The old Linux parser is NUL-terminated and silently discards excess records; the old Windows parser assumes one message fits its buffer. Shared bytes/length decoder and EOF finalization must replace those assumptions for rich records without weakening legacy forwards.

The current parser only logs detailed input reasons; a controller-only enum or log interceptor cannot satisfy origin propagation. Structured parser evidence needs isolation under recursive calls and parallel worker threads.

Changing negotiated success to require FINAL must not invalidate legacy subprocess fixture semantics or direct slave modes; tests must establish the explicit mode boundary, without adding an implicit fallback after a bad negotiated handshake.
Signal/timeout paths must not use mutexes/heap/stdio inside asynchronous handler context. New event writes must not corrupt legacy crash evidence, and unavailable transport must leave uncertainty.

The budget must cover fresh independent checks of the full CPU matrix; use shared source caches/pinned dependencies and isolated out-of-tree build directories, without treating prior different-candidate passes as evidence.
scope: One unsplit work unit for https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/18; carry detected parse/creation/timeout facts through bounded stable private event representation to both robust controllers.

Migrate the controlled parser slice from issue #17 to structured origin evidence without changing public bool parse/callback behavior; preserve genuine raw parser/Vulkan/native errors only where available.

Add negotiated framed event and FINAL records to existing child transport; preserve legacy progress/resume/crash grammar and SharedControlBlock interface; classify missing/truncated/unsupported rich reports honestly.

Commit assertion-bearing unit, producer and real-controller regressions plus changelog and concise protocol/verification documentation. Retain Windows implementation and portable registration with native Windows execution waived.
